## Thursday

At the first lab, there will be a few demonstrations, games and discussions. You won't need to do any programming yourself yet.

## Friday

We will start the tutorial by updating/installing R, RStudio and the tidyverse library (follow the lab instructions to complete these steps). 

Then, we will guide you to create a tidy folder structure for use in the course.
